title: Long time no see!
goal: Talk about changes using a starting point or duration
freeConversationInstruction: What’s new with you? Catch up on something that’s changed or a habit you’ve had for a long time

pages.title: Review the last lesson
pages.instruction: Find out about a hobby. Talk about something you’ve tried or would like to try

items.prompt: Have you ever tried a new hobby?
items.hint: I’ve tried painting / Not yet, but I’d like to try it
items.cue: Say which hobby you’ve tried or would like to try

items.prompt: When did you start, or when would you like to try it?
items.hint: I started last year / I’d like to try it this weekend
items.cue: Give a past time or a possible date

items.prompt: Would you like to do it with someone?
items.hint: I’d go with a friend / I’d like to try it on my own
items.cue: Say who you’d go with, or say you’d do it alone

pages.title: Name the pictures
pages.instruction: Say each word or expression in English, then click a picture to check and listen

items.audioText: move to a new city. She moved to a new city in 2023.

finish a course. I’ve finished an online course.
get married. They got married in June.

pages.title: Practise the conversation
pages.instruction: You are Ana and Teacher is Kim. Practise together, swap roles, then answer the questions

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Long time no see! Are you still living in the same city?
lines.audioText: Long time no see! Are you still living in the same city?
lines.translation: Quanto tempo! Você ainda mora na mesma cidade?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: No, I moved to Porto in 2023
lines.audioText: No, I moved to Porto in 2023.
lines.translation: Não, eu me mudei para o Porto em 2023

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: How long have you lived there?
lines.audioText: How long have you lived there?
lines.translation: Há quanto tempo você mora lá?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Since 2023. I really like it, and I’ve made some good friends
lines.audioText: Since 2023. I really like it, and I’ve made some good friends.
lines.translation: Desde 2023. Gosto muito de lá e fiz bons amigos

questions.prompt: What positive change does she mention?
questions.answer: Ana has made some good friends

pages.title: Practise the conversation
pages.instruction: You are Ana and Teacher is Kim. Practise together, swap roles, then answer the questions

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: That’s great. Have you taken up any new hobbies?
lines.audioText: That’s great. Have you taken up any new hobbies?
lines.translation: Que bom. Você começou algum hobby novo?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes, I started a photography group in 2025
lines.audioText: Yes, I started a photography group in 2025.
lines.translation: Sim, comecei um grupo de fotografia em 2025

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Do you still go every week?
lines.audioText: Do you still go every week?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I do. We meet on Sundays. What’s changed in your life?
lines.audioText: I do. We meet on Sundays. What’s changed in your life?
lines.translation: Sim. Nos encontramos aos domingos. O que mudou na sua vida?

questions.prompt: What new hobby has Ana taken up?
questions.answer: Ana has joined a photography group

questions.prompt: How often does the group meet?
questions.answer: The photography group meets on Sundays

pages.title: Talk about yourself
pages.instruction: Catch up after a long time. Answer in your own way and ask your teacher a follow-up question

items.prompt: How long have you lived in your city?
items.cue: Say a duration or a starting year

items.prompt: Has anything changed for you recently?
items.cue: Share a small change or say things are the same
items.hint: I’ve started a course / Things are much the same

items.prompt: What would you like to do next?
items.cue: Share a plan and ask about my plans
items.hint: I’d like to … What about you?

pages.title: Use for and since with the present perfect
pages.instruction: Describe a situation that started in the past and continues now

rows.subject: How long
rows.verb: have / has + past participle + for + duration
rows.example: I’ve lived here for three years

rows.subject: Since when
rows.verb: have / has + past participle + since + starting point

rows.subject: Ask about the duration
rows.verb: How long + have / has + subject + past participle?
rows.example: How long have you lived here? — Since 2023

pages.note: For introduces a length of time; since introduces its beginning. For a finished move, use past simple: I moved here in 2023.

pages.title: Tell the story
pages.instruction: Catch up after a long time. Choose a change and tell me what is different now

pages.title: Listen and answer
pages.instruction: An update to the profile. Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana! Here’s the update for our fictional profile. I moved to Porto in 2023, and I’ve lived here since then. I started the photography group in 2025, and I still go on Sundays. I haven’t changed jobs, but I’ve finished an online course. I’m really enjoying the city now. What would you like to ask about my new routine?
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana! Here’s the update for our fictional profile. I moved to Porto in 2023, and I’ve lived here since then. I started the photography group in 2025, and I still go on Sundays. I haven’t changed jobs, but I’ve finished an online course. I’m really enjoying the city now. What would you like to ask about my new routine?
